event_title: Topic: Growth Hacking 101: Driving Startup Growth Creatively
description:
Join this session to unlock unconventional paths to rapid growth through practical growth hacking strategies. Learn how to design creative experiments, analyze outcomes, and apply data-driven insights to achieve high-impact results. Through real-world case studies, startups will discover how to test ideas quickly, optimize resources, and accelerate traction. Participants will gain actionable strategies to scale efficiently, drive sustainable growth, and outperform in competitive markets.

Led by Neetu Bansal, Business Coach and Mentor passionate about helping businesses thrive. A business owner since 17, she brings entrepreneurial insight and acts as a trusted advisor for startups, early-stage ventures, and growing companies. Specializing in SMEs, family businesses, and tech startups, Neetu partners with accelerators and associations to deliver workshops and mentoring sessions focused on driving business and revenue growth through holistic optimization.

event_title: Mastering Metrics: Leveraging Analytics for Startup Success
description:
"Join this session to learn how to build a structured rhythm for data reviews that keeps teams and investors aligned. Discover how to distinguish vanity from actionable metrics, define key KPIs for your business model (B2B vs B2C), and explore sector-specific examples from SaaS, Edtech, and Agritech. This session equips founders to design a data-driven review framework that supports growth, transparency, and strategic decision-making.

Led by Sriram Chidambaram, Founder of Spice Route Finance, a financial advisory firm specializing in Virtual CFO services. With over 22 years of experience in strategic and operational finance, Sriram has guided 50+ startups and enterprises across food tech, fintech, e-commerce, and edtech in building scalable financial models for long-term success."

event_title: Market Ready: Designing a Winning Go-to-Market Strategy
description:
"Join this session to craft a results-driven Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy that ensures strong early traction and customer acquisition. Learn to identify your target market, position your offering effectively, and select high-impact marketing and sales channels to maximize value from day one. This hands-on session equips startups with the tools to build momentum and drive scalable growth from launch.

Led by Vedanarayanan Vedantham (Veda), a seasoned B2B business leader who has driven consistent revenue growth across SaaS, Fintech, Healthtech, and Edtech. With leadership roles at Microsoft Asia, Razorpay, HealthifyMe, and Simplilearn, Veda now leads global GTM strategy for Gen-AI at Chargebee. An alumnus of INSEAD Singapore and SPJIMR, Mumbai, he brings deep expertise in AI, marketing, and growth strategy.
LinkedIn: Vedanarayanan Vedantham

"Join this session to learn how to design a scalable business model by analyzing revenue streams, cost structures, and scalability drivers. Gain insights into planning for operational efficiency and long-term profitability to build a foundation for exponential and sustainable growth. By the end, startups will be equipped to optimize resources, streamline operations, and structure their business for scale and investor readiness.

Led by Vikrant Potnis, Founder of FundEnable, specializing in startup funding, strategy, and M&A. He has facilitated major investment deals, advised multiple incubators, and collaborated with investment committees to identify and nurture high-potential startups. Committed to bridging the gap between entrepreneurs and investors, he drives strategic growth through education and partnerships. LinkedIn"

event_title: Perfecting Your Pitch: Techniques for Winning Over Investors
description:
"Join this session to learn how to perfect your investor pitch for IT services startups. Learn to define your business problem, showcase market opportunities with clear data, highlight your team’s strengths, and engage investors effectively. The session also covers leveraging networks, sharing polished decks, and avoiding common pitfalls like cluttered slides or misaligned messaging. By the end, founders will have practical strategies to create a compelling pitch that increases funding success and accelerates growth.

Led by Aditya Arora, CEO of Faad Capital, a SEBI-registered CAT-1 fund managing $40 million, and angel investor in 20+ startups. An award-winning entrepreneur, he has received the Parliamentary Award, REX Karamveer Chakra (UN), and Indian Achiever Award 2020, delivered 200+ lectures globally, and led Faad Capital to invest in 113+ startups recognized by Economic Times and Inc42."

event_title: Competitive Edge: Crafting Your Strategy and Positioning in the Market
description:
Join this session to master competitive analysis and product positioning to set your MVP apart in a crowded market. Learn practical methods to evaluate competitors, identify market gaps, and define your unique value proposition. Discover how to position your product effectively, communicate differentiation, and create a compelling narrative that resonates with customers and investors alike. By the end, startups will gain the tools to carve out a distinct market space and build a brand that stands strong amid competition.

Led by Gunjan Pai, Founder of Copylove, a boutique brand strategy and copywriting studio built on her 23+ years of experience with top companies, brands, and entrepreneurs. Copylove’s all-women remote team specializes in purpose-led brand communication, working with clients like Facebook, CRED, and TATA Steel. Gunjan’s values-driven approach combines strategic storytelling with social impact, donating 1% of Copylove’s quarterly revenue to street animal welfare.

event_title: Strategic Decisions: When to Pivot and When to Persevere
description:
"Making the right strategic choice at key moments can define your startup’s future. In this session, learn how to assess whether to persist, pivot, or pause using clear frameworks and real-world case studies. Understand how to read market signals, interpret customer feedback, and align growth metrics with strategy. Walk away with practical tools to avoid premature pivots and confidently navigate high-stakes decisions.

Led by Aditya Mohanty, product strategist and community builder behind The Product Folks (200K+ members) and The Product House (50K+ Web3 members). Formerly with ed-tech unicorn Emeritus, Aditya brings hands-on experience scaling products and guiding startups through critical growth phases. He also shares insights on product, growth, and life at adityamohanty.com

event_title: Modeling Success: Utilizing the Business Model Canvas for Strategic Planning
description:
The Business Model Canvas (BMC) helps startups clearly visualize and refine their business model. In this session, you’ll learn how to use the BMC to define how your startup creates, delivers, and captures value. You will map key elements like customer segments, value propositions, revenue streams, and cost structures to identify strengths, gaps, and opportunities for improvement. This framework will help you align your strategy, support informed decision-making, and plan for sustainable growth. By the end, founders will have a clear and practical blueprint to communicate their model to investors and partners.

The session is led by Ajay Rungta, a seasoned tech expert with 15+ years of experience. As the Founding Engineer at Practo, he spent over a decade driving growth and product innovation. Now a solopreneur, advisor, mentor, and angel investor, he has guided 50+ founders across sectors like HealthTech, EdTech, MedTech, AI/ML, D2C, Mobility, and DevTools.

event_title: Crafting Your North Star: Defining Mission, Vision, and Values
description:
"Join this session to learn how to define and activate your Mission, Vision, and Values—the strategic North Star of any startup. Discover how these elements create clarity, alignment, and differentiation, especially in India’s competitive IT services sector. Learn to craft statements that drive culture, guide decisions, and evolve with your business. Avoid common pitfalls and integrate your North Star into hiring, strategy, and operations for lasting impact.

Led by Susila Cherla, Founder of Ostranenie Products & Management Consulting Services. With 23+ years across R&D, supply chain, and digital transformation, she has mentored 400+ startups on strategy, pricing, and MVPs as an ISB-certified mentor and advisor with I-Venture@ISB and Wadhwani Foundation."

description:
"For early-stage startups, integrating customer insights is critical to shaping an MVP that aligns with real market needs. This session bridges the gap between theory and execution, teaching founders how to set up effective feedback channels such as surveys, focus groups, user testing, and interviews. Startups will learn to analyze feedback to validate personas, define market segments, and refine their MVP, ensuring resources are directed toward validated opportunities. The outcome is reduced risk, stronger product-market fit, and faster growth.

Led by Ajay Rungta, Founding Engineer at Practo and now a startup advisor, mentor, angel investor, and super connector with 15+ years of experience. Having supported numerous founders through accelerators, pitch reviews, cohort evaluations, and masterclasses, he brings a collaborative, hands-on approach that helps transform insights into strategies that scale."

Led by Suhas Motwani, Founder of The Product Folks and The Founder Folks — one of Asia’s largest product and tech communities with over 200,000 members. He also created Indistract, a productivity app suite with over a million downloads, and previously scaled internal products at PepsiCo Europe.
